document_title: AI Mode (Gemini Integration) - What You Experience
description: What happens when you enable AI-powered features

what_ai_mode_does.story_analysis: AI reads your entire book and understands the plot, characters, and themes
what_ai_mode_does.auto_descriptions: AI writes YouTube descriptions for you
what_ai_mode_does.multi_speaker_audio: AI assigns different voices to different characters

enabling_ai_mode.from_menu: Not yet available in menu (coming soon)

api_key_needed.prompt: 'Enter your Gemini API key (get one free at makersuite.google.com):'
api_key_needed.after_entering: '✅ API key saved. You won't need to enter it again.'

phase_1_story_analysis.when_it_happens: After you select an EPUB, before processing begins
what_you_see: '   Sending book to Gemini AI for analysis...'
'   This only happens once per book and may take 30-60 seconds.'
phase_1_story_analysis.cached_for_future: If you process more chapters later, analysis is reused (no extra API calls)

what_you_see: 1. The Uzumaki Legacy: A Naruto Reborn Story
2. From Zero to Hokage: Naruto's Second Chance
3. Naruto SI - The Hidden Leaf's New Legend
5. The Sage's Return: Naruto Reincarnation Story
what_you_do: Type 1-5 to select a suggested title
Type 'c' to enter your own custom title
Type 's' to skip and use original EPUB title

what_you_see: What if Naruto woke up with memories of his past life?
In this gripping fanfiction, our favorite ninja gets
a second chance to save everyone he loves...
ai_generated_description.if_you_accept: This description is saved to the output folder
ai_generated_description.if_you_edit: A text editor opens so you can modify it

phase_2_multi_speaker_audio.when_enabled: Requires both AI mode AND Chatterbox TTS to be available

how_it_works.step_1: AI reads each chapter before processing
how_it_works.step_3: AI assigns voices: narrator voice for prose, character voices for dialogue

chatterbox_limit.why_limited: Chatterbox is slower and uses more resources
chatterbox_limit.what_you_see: 'ℹ️ Chatterbox used for 8 of 15 dialogue segments (limit to preserve quality)'
chatterbox_limit.overflow: Excess dialogue uses Piper voice instead

ai_generated_intros.normal_intro: Uses the static text from your config (Yo legends, welcome back...)

ai_intro.what_happens: AI writes a custom intro based on what happens in this batch
example: 'Naruto finally faces Orochimaru, Sasuke makes a shocking choice,'
'and we learn the truth about the Fourth Hokage. Lock in!'
ai_intro.benefit: Each video has a unique, context-aware intro

is_it_free.answer: Gemini has a generous free tier
is_it_free.free_limit: Approximately 60 queries per minute, 1500 per day

if_rate_limited.what_you_see: '⚠️ Gemini rate limit reached. Waiting 60 seconds...'

when_ai_is_not_available.no_api_key: AI features are simply skipped, normal processing continues
when_ai_is_not_available.network_error: '⚠️ Could not reach Gemini API. Continuing without AI features.'
when_ai_is_not_available.everything_else_works: The core audio/video generation doesn't require AI
